recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12942 unless Patient Care later reopens the separate AllergyIntolerance.category binding/datatype design question.
issue_request: FHIR-12942 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue for FHIR-core-AllergyIntolerance requesting that AllergyIntolerance.category be changed to datatype code, cardinality 0..*, with a required binding.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies svn revision 11548. The corresponding git-svn commit c0df469417b5ac953e7c5295d192eff6d12c484a (build@11548, 2017-03-09) changed the AllergyIntolerance.category spreadsheet row from CodeableConcept to code while preserving 0..*. This reversed only the datatype part of the earlier FHIR-11352 application that had made the element 0..* CodeableConcept.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has AllergyIntolerance.category as min 0, max *, type code, isSummary true, and a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/allergy-intolerance-category. The FHIR-12136 optional-category search warning remains in the same element comment. Later FHIR-45243 considered loosening the binding and datatype design but was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build source already implements the FHIR-12942 request and remains consistent with the later no-change decision about the category binding.
